# gigahost_server_catalog (Data Source)

Returns the full deploy catalog: every product tier, product, and region, including raw `product_id`/`price_id`. Prefer `gigahost_server_size` for selecting a single size by slug; use this to enumerate the whole catalog.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The full deploy catalog: every tier, product, and region.
data "gigahost_server_catalog" "all" {}

output "product_names" {
  value = flatten([for t in data.gigahost_server_catalog.all.tiers : [for p in t.products : p.name]])
}
```
